title: What is Local TV Advertising: Types, Benefits & Costs | Strategus

facts.fact: Strategus ran a 2-month local CTV campaign for a home remodeling company, targeting homeowners in eight areas.
facts.quote: They partnered with Strategus to run a 2-month campaign targeting homeowners in eight areas.

facts.fact: In the Strategus home remodeling case study, the campaign targeted households earning $50,000 and homes valued at $100,000 or more.
facts.quote: It focused on households earning $50,000 and homes valued at $100,000 or more, particularly those that had shown interest in home improvement.

facts.fact: According to Strategus's home remodeling case study, the campaign produced 90,269 website visits.
facts.quote: The results: 90,269 website visits and 4,094 in-store visits.

facts.fact: According to Strategus's home remodeling case study, the campaign produced 4,094 in-store visits.
